description: This file contains the 'TaxRate' class within the Opencart admin controller namespace, responsible for managing tax rate tasks such as generation, information retrieval, and cleanup of tax rate JSON files. It includes methods for creating tasks for each geo zone, providing details about a specific geo zone, and deleting generated files.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Controller class for managing tax rate tasks in the Opencart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of tax rate tasks for all geo zones by creating individual tasks for each geo zone.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates and saves detailed tax rate information for a specified geo zone, outputting JSON data to a file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes all generated tax rate JSON files from the designated directory.
